src/integrations/uniswap-v4/UniswapV4Int.reason: The market's PoolKey is fixed at bindMarket, which already refuses any hook outside the allowlist, and the allowlist is empty and immutable (only address(0) passes), so the re-check at receivePosition (REQ-AMM-V4-001) can never fail for a bound market.
